tools.name: merchant_pricing
tools.description: Free, machine-readable merchant fee and loyalty tiers for 402Proof standard x402 v2 XRPL exact resource servers. List $0.0100; 20% discount after 100 prior successful merchant settlements, 30% after 1,000 and 50% after 10,000. Merchant-side fees accrue separately from buyer payments and are NOT auto

tools.name: platform_stats
tools.description: Live 402Proof platform stats: total payments, volume, active agents. Free.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Request a payment invoice for any SqueezeOS endpoint. Returns destination address, amount, and payment_options for XRPL (RLUSD or USDC), Xahau (native XAH), Base (USDC), or Solana (USDC-SPL). Pass currency='USDC' and chain='solana' for Solana; pass asset='XAH' (or chain='xahau') for the Xahau rail.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Submit tx_hash after paying an invoice. Supports XRPL, Xahau, Base (0x… hash), and Solana. Returns a signed JWT access_token (1-hour TTL). For a Xahau invoice with fee_required=true, also submit fee_tx_hash (the 0.01 XAH facilitator-fee payment) — settlement requires both payments. Free.

tools.name: check_loyalty
tools.description: Loyalty tier and free-call balance for any XRPL wallet. Automatic — no registration. Free.

tools.name: get_compliance_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve a tamper-evident compliance receipt by UUID. Contains XRPL tx hash, agent wallet, endpoint, amount, and timestamp. Free.

tools.name: get_agent_passport
tools.description: Full Agent Passport for any XRPL wallet: payment history, risk score 0-100, loyalty tier, passport hash. Free.

tools.name: bureau_public_score
tools.description: FICO-style 300-850 Agent Credit Bureau score for any XRPL wallet. Includes grade and loyalty tier. Free.

tools.name: bureau_full_report
tools.description: Full credit bureau report: score breakdown, spend history, risk factors. Cost: 0.01 RLUSD.

tools.name: bureau_verify_threshold
tools.description: Boolean creditworthiness check — is this wallet above a score threshold? Cost: 0.005 RLUSD.

tools.name: bureau_get_attestation
tools.description: Portable attestation JWT (24h TTL) proving creditworthiness. Cost: 0.01 RLUSD.

tools.name: bureau_verify_attestation
tools.description: Verify a bureau attestation JWT. Free.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_invoice" is 635 chars, far longer than this server's median (98). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
